This is a list of monthly issues of the {{pkmn|manga}} series [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]. These monthly American-style comic books were released by [[VIZ Media]] before the release of the collected volumes.

Each volume of The Electric Tale of Pikachu was given a name by VIZ Media, and the monthly comic issues that compose each individual volume correspond to each volume's name. Therefore, the numbering of the issues resets at the beginning of every new volume. For example, [[ET05]] is the chapter in the first issue of Pikachu Shocks Back, and the fifth monthly issue overall.

While the English versions of these manga books have been translated into other languages worldwide, they are not available in Japan or {{pmin|Singapore}}.
